untested_modules.gap: No dedicated unit test file. DecisionEngine.recommend() is only tested indirectly through E2E and reliability tests. No tests for algorithm selection, boundary conditions, or invalid FarmState values.

No dedicated unit test file. DigitalTwin.simulate() tested indirectly. No tests for algorithm selection (logistic_growth vs other), _step() correctness, _temp_factor()/_water_factor() boundary values, or multi-day simulation accuracy.

No dedicated unit test file. Only 2 reliability tests (empty sequence, no PAM site). No tests for: guide length correctness, PAM sequence variants, GC content bounds, off-target scoring, efficiency scoring, multiple guides, or custom PAM/guide_length parameters.

No dedicated unit test file. Only 2 reliability tests (empty sequence, invalid amino acid). No tests for: molecular weight accuracy, isoelectric point bounds, hydrophobicity, composition sums to 1.0, stability score bounds, instability index, or known protein sequences.
No test coverage at all. ModuleRegistry is completely untested. No tests for tier filtering, module listing, or invalid tier handling.
No test coverage at all. OrganizationProfiler is completely untested. No tests for tier recommendation boundaries, zero/negative inputs, or revenue/employee edge cases.

gaps.description: TSP property tests exist in test_property_based.py but only cover tour validity and cost consistency. Missing: Christofides approximation ratio ≤ 1.5× optimal for metric instances, nearest-neighbor produces valid tours for all inputs, symmetric distance matrix produces symmetric tours.
gaps.recommendation: Add hypothesis tests for Christofides approximation ratio bound and nearest-neighbor tour validity across random metric instances.

gaps.description: VRP property tests exist but only cover capacity and coverage invariants. Missing: route cost equals sum of edge distances, all customers visited exactly once across all routes, empty customer list produces empty routes.
gaps.recommendation: Add hypothesis tests for route cost calculation correctness and complete customer coverage.

gaps.description: No property-based tests for task allocation. Missing: all tasks assigned exactly once, total cost equals sum of assigned costs, Hungarian algorithm produces optimal assignment for square matrices, rectangular matrix handling.
gaps.recommendation: Add hypothesis tests using random cost matrices to verify assignment invariants.

gaps.description: Consensus property tests exist but only cover quorum calculation. Missing: tally correctness for random vote distributions, n ≥ 3f+1 constraint validation, Byzantine fault tolerance with f faulty nodes.
gaps.recommendation: Add hypothesis tests for Byzantine fault tolerance with random vote distributions.

gaps.description: No property-based tests for protein analysis. Missing: composition sums to 1.0, molecular weight > 0 for valid sequences, isoelectric point in [0, 14], stability score in [0, 1], hydrophobicity bounds.
gaps.recommendation: Add hypothesis tests using random valid amino acid sequences to verify all output invariants.

gaps.description: No property-based tests for CRISPR design. Missing: guide length always equals configured length, PAM always ends with GG, GC content in [0, 1], off-target score in [0, 1], efficiency score bounds.
gaps.recommendation: Add hypothesis tests using random DNA sequences to verify guide design invariants.

gaps.description: No property-based tests for ontology. Missing: search scores sorted descending, concept count tracks add/remove, RDF roundtrip preserves all concepts, transitive closure correctness.
gaps.recommendation: Add hypothesis tests for ontology invariants using random concept/relationship graphs.

gaps.description: No property-based tests for knowledge graph. Missing: path existence transitivity, node degree bounds, edge weight non-negativity, query result consistency.
gaps.recommendation: Add hypothesis tests for knowledge graph invariants using random graph structures.

gaps.description: No property-based tests for sensor placement. Missing: coverage ratio in [0, 1], placement count ≤ target count, radius bounds respected, all targets covered when possible.
gaps.recommendation: Add hypothesis tests for sensor placement invariants using random target/radius configurations.

gaps.description: No property-based tests for coverage planning. Missing: path continuity, swath overlap bounds, complete coverage for simple boundaries, path cost monotonicity.
gaps.recommendation: Add hypothesis tests for coverage path invariants using random boundary shapes.

gaps.description: MQTTClient has concurrency tests in test_concurrency.py but KafkaStream and TimescaleDBStorage do not. Missing: concurrent produce/consume, thread-safe offset tracking, connection pool exhaustion.
gaps.recommendation: Add thread-safety tests for KafkaStream and TimescaleDBStorage concurrent access patterns.

gaps.description: No concurrency tests for EventBus. Missing: concurrent publish/subscribe, thread-safe handler registration, event ordering under contention, handler exception isolation.
gaps.recommendation: Add thread-safety tests for EventBus concurrent publish/subscribe patterns.

gaps.description: No concurrency tests for swarm coordination. Missing: concurrent task claims, thread-safe state updates, agent failure during coordination, split-brain prevention.
gaps.recommendation: Add concurrency tests for swarm agent coordination under parallel execution.

gaps.description: AuditLogger has concurrency tests in test_audit.py but only for event ID uniqueness. Missing: concurrent event logging, thread-safe event_count, filter consistency under concurrent writes.
gaps.recommendation: Add concurrent logging tests to verify event ordering and count accuracy.

gaps.description: No async/await concurrency tests anywhere. All concurrency tests use threading. Missing: async event loop tests, async I/O race conditions, asyncio.gather correctness, async generator safety.
gaps.recommendation: Add asyncio-based tests for any async-capable modules (data_pipeline, event_bus, api_gateway).

gaps.description: No mutation testing framework is configured or used. No mutmut, cosmic-ray, or similar tool in dev dependencies. Mutation testing is completely absent.
gaps.recommendation: Add mutmut or cosmic-ray to dev dependencies. Start with core algorithms (TSP, VRP, consensus, task allocation) to measure test suite strength.

gaps.description: TSP solver has no mutation testing. Cannot verify that tests catch off-by-one errors, incorrect distance calculations, or algorithm selection bugs.
gaps.recommendation: Run mutation testing on TSP solver to identify weak test assertions.

gaps.description: Consensus has no mutation testing. Cannot verify that tests catch quorum calculation errors, tally bugs, or Byzantine fault handling issues.
gaps.recommendation: Run mutation testing on consensus to verify Byzantine fault tolerance test coverage.

gaps.description: test_regression.py has 45 tests but none reference specific bug IDs, issue numbers, or commit hashes. Regression tests cannot be traced to the original defects they prevent.
gaps.recommendation: Add bug-ID references to regression test docstrings (e.g., 'Regression test for #42: TSP empty cities crash').

gaps.description: No regression tests for DecisionEngine. The recommend() method is only tested indirectly. No tests for specific recommendation scenarios (e.g., low moisture → irrigate, high temperature → shade).
gaps.recommendation: Add regression tests for specific DecisionEngine recommendation scenarios.

gaps.description: No regression tests for DigitalTwin simulation accuracy. No tests for known simulation edge cases (e.g., crop death at extreme temperature, growth saturation at optimal conditions).
gaps.recommendation: Add regression tests for DigitalTwin simulation edge cases and known accuracy issues.

gaps.description: DecisionEngine.recommend() has no dedicated edge case tests. Missing: all-zero FarmState, extreme values (moisture=0, temp=50), negative values, None values, boundary thresholds.
gaps.recommendation: Add edge case tests for DecisionEngine with boundary and invalid FarmState values.

gaps.description: DigitalTwin.simulate() has limited edge case coverage. Missing: negative days, zero days, extreme temperature (0°C, 50°C), zero moisture, full moisture, very long simulations (365+ days).
gaps.recommendation: Add comprehensive edge case tests for DigitalTwin simulation boundaries.

gaps.description: CRISPRDesigner has minimal edge case coverage. Missing: very short DNA sequences, sequences with no valid PAM, sequences with multiple PAM sites, lowercase DNA, non-ACGT characters, custom PAM sequences.
gaps.recommendation: Add edge case tests for CRISPRDesigner with various DNA sequence inputs.

gaps.description: ProteinAnalyzer has minimal edge case coverage. Missing: single amino acid, very long sequences, all-same-amino-acid sequences, sequences with rare amino acids (U, O, B, Z, X), lowercase input.
gaps.recommendation: Add edge case tests for ProteinAnalyzer with various sequence inputs.

gaps.description: ModuleRegistry has no tests at all. Missing: invalid tier names, empty module lists, tier with no modules, duplicate module names.
gaps.recommendation: Create test_onboarding.py with edge case tests for ModuleRegistry.

gaps.description: OrganizationProfiler has no tests at all. Missing: zero employees, negative revenue, very large organizations, boundary between tiers, fractional employees.
gaps.recommendation: Create test_onboarding.py with edge case tests for OrganizationProfiler.

gaps.description: No conftest.py exists. Shared fixtures (e.g., common test data, mock objects, temp directories) must be duplicated across test files.
gaps.recommendation: Create tests/conftest.py with shared fixtures for common test data and mock objects.

gaps.description: No GitHub Actions CI workflow found. test_infrastructure.py checks for CI workflow existence but the file may not exist. Tests are not automatically run on push/PR.
gaps.recommendation: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml with pytest, ruff, and bandit steps.

gaps.description: No coverage reporting configured. Makefile has test-cov target but no coverage thresholds or enforcement. No coverage badge or reporting.
gaps.recommendation: Add coverage thresholds (e.g., --cov-fail-under=80) and integrate with codecov or similar.

gaps.description: No test categorization or markers. All tests run in a single suite with no way to run subsets (e.g., unit vs integration vs property-based).
gaps.recommendation: Add pytest markers (e.g., @pytest.mark.unit, @pytest.mark.integration, @pytest.mark.property) for selective test execution.

gaps.description: No test timeout configuration. Slow tests (e.g., performance tests, large TSP instances) can hang indefinitely.
gaps.recommendation: Add pytest-timeout configuration with per-test or global timeout limits.
